handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Gemini while Codex completes higher-priority work.

All three canonical artifacts produced and verified: (1) MARKET_SCOPE_AND_INSTRUMENT_POLICY.md — v1 markets (US, TW, CRYPTO), instrument scopes, data-class matrix, StrategySpec constraints, stage-eligibility. (2) DATA_SOURCE_SCOPE_MATRIX.md — source-class matrix (A–F) for all three markets, 10 market-data questions answered, truth ownership explicit, paper/canary/live eligibility defined. (3) SYMBOL_MASTER_AND_CONTRACT_MASTER_POLICY.md — SecurityMaster and ContractMaster schemas, per-market symbol mapping rules, delisting/rename policy, StrategySpec integration path. All acceptance criteria met. Moving to review for Codex.
Codex review approved. The three GAP-00 canonical policies are coherent with the source plan, mutually cross-referenced, and satisfy the review gate. Owner may finalize BG-000 as done.
BG-000 artifacts are complete and aligned; continue with reviewer pass on a healthy lane.

Review approved. Three canonical policy docs are coherent, complete, and satisfy the materialization contract. DatasetVersion gap correctly deferred to BG-001. Returning to owner (Gemini) for finalization.
